accuracyFlags: Petrol A$2.08/L and diesel A$2.47/L are Fuel Plan five-city averages for 5 August 2026; on 19 October they are 10 weeks stale yet the page says 'current official city benchmarks' and 'Updated 18 August 2026'.
The three worked examples (1,000 km at 8, 12 and 15 L/100 km) are arithmetic on those stale prices; they will mislead if the price has moved.
